notes:
One typescript continuation with four entries on pages 25–28, a typed interlinear qualification, a handwritten insertion connector and a handwritten footnote. Its own number is - 7 -, with the left dash raised, and its archive number is 71; no title, date or signature is present. The number is not an explicit statement of a total page count. No cancellation, formal display or mathematical diagram is visible.

The author asks for a ‘hint pour’ ‘il n’est pas difficile de montrer ...’, questions ‘dont on peut penser que c’est le même ...’ with ‘y a-t-il ... une caractérisation d’un homomorphisme (7.17.4.1) ?’, and qualifies that question by ‘(dans la situation présente, i.e. S local régulier de pt fermé s)’. The handwritten question reads ‘Est-ce que 7.2 ne [x|se] généralise pas ?’; the square-bracket alternatives here report the transcription’s uncertainty, not marks supplied by the writer. The p.27 entry explicitly contrasts ‘au-dessus’ with ‘au dessus’, and ‘dans le normalisé’ with ‘du normalisé’. The p.28 entry reports the missing Abhyankar reference.

The one explicit C doubt, repeated in C’s context table, remains unresolved. The connector and the detached lower-right cluster are restored; the cluster’s two lobes and small satellite are represented without calling them punctuation or assigning an author. H supplies description only and has no collation rows. These are reports of the page’s questions and requests; no proof or mathematical computation was performed.
math_reading_decisions: Each reference field was read by components in half a: p.25, li.10; p.26, li.10; p.27, li.1 et 2; p.28; and (7.17.4.1). Their recurring serifed and curved numeral impressions are typewritten. No digit was reclassified as handwritten merely for having a curved form.
The single capital S in the typed interlinear parenthesis has one ordinary S contour without independent double striking. The terminal s is an ordinary lower-case typed s. Neither is handwritten.
The parenthetical abbreviation pt has both letters on the same typed baseline; it is not a raised t abbreviation. The punctuation of i.e. consists of a point after each letter.

The call (1) at the end of the p.26 entry and the opening (1) of the note are handwritten: each has a small raised 1 between taller parentheses. The 7.2 within the note is handwritten as part of that line.

The typed quotation clusters retain paired high quotation strokes; each quoted ellipsis in the p.25 and p.26 entries has three separate low points. The final question mark is outside the closing quotation in the p.25 entry.

The C_context au-dessus/au dessus target was checked independently: first hyphen present, second absent. The p.25, p.26, p.28 summaries and page-number/archive-number targets likewise agree in their words and values; the omitted number-flanking strokes and insertion connector are separately reported.
The long curve is an insertion connector, not a mathematical arrow or an underline assigned to the parenthetical words. Its descending left branch fixes the insertion point immediately before une.
No mathematical inference, proof verification, external background lookup, or computation was used to settle a symbol. The authorial questions are transcribed without answering them.
